name: mirage
text:
You are right, and my last answer was wrong. The separate Kalshi tab was taken out of the bottom bar when Kalshi and Novig bets were merged into the +EV tab (v1.0.14-16, your request of 2026-10-21).

The Kalshi pages still exist and open from the +EV tab. With Kalshi switched on in the Novig / Kalshi chips, tap the "Kalshi arb, bids, auto, setup" button at the top of the list. It opens the Kalshi screen, and its Auto page has the "Most per day" chips ($25, $50, $100, $250, $500). Raise that limit there and your by-hand Kalshi bets go through again.
